title: Grilled Norwegian Fish with Jammy Glaze
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring grilled Norwegian fish topped with a sweet and sticky jammy glaze.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Brush the fish with olive oil and marinate in lemon juice for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the fish for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is grilling, heat the jammy glaze in a small saucepan over low heat.
Brush the jammy glaze over the fish during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the grilled fish hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
